item: Grilled Chicken Breast Protein Bowl
description: Succulent grilled chicken breast served with organic brown rice, steamed broccoli, roasted bell peppers, and a light herb vinaigrette.

item: Keto Avocado and Egg Green Salad
description: Rich avocado chunks, boiled free-range eggs, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, and a mix of leafy spinach and romaine, finished with extra virgin olive oil and pumpkin seeds.

item: Paneer Tikka Quinoa & Brown Rice Bowl
description: Tender spiced paneer tikka cubes cooked on a clay oven grill, layered over a protein-rich blend of quinoa and brown rice, with cucumber mint yogurt and grilled capsicum.

item: Spiced Foxtail Millet Khichdi
description: A comforting, high-fiber, and diabetic-friendly khichdi made with whole foxtail millet, yellow moong dal, carrots, green peas, and clarified butter (ghee) tempering with cumin.

item: Low Carb Almond Flour Chicken Wrap
description: Tender shredded tandoori chicken, sliced onions, and bell peppers wrapped in a keto-certified house-made almond flour flatbread with light Greek yogurt mint spread.

item: Teriyaki Sesame Tofu Protein Bowl
description: Crispy pan-seared high-protein tofu glazed with low-sodium teriyaki sauce, served on a bed of steamed red rice, edamame, and lightly steamed bok choy.

item: Slow Cooked Lentil & Vegetable Soup
description: A thick, hearty soup packed with red lentils, diced sweet potatoes, celery, spinach, and tomatoes, simmered gently with turmeric and black pepper. Rich in plant fiber.

item: Lemon Herb Baked Salmon Tikka
description: Omega-3 rich salmon fillets marinated in fresh dill, lemon zest, garlic, and cooked gently in an oven. Served with sautéed beans and carrot ribbons.

item: Mediterranean Chickpea & Feta Salad
description: Boiled kabuli chickpeas tossed with crumbled feta cheese, kalamata olives, crunchy cucumbers, bell peppers, fresh parsley, and a lemon-oregano vinaigrette.

item: Paneer Bhurji & Almond Roti Combo
description: Scrambled cottage cheese (paneer) sautéed with onions, green chilies, tomatoes, and fresh coriander, accompanied by two warm keto-friendly almond flour rotis.

item: Triple Cheese Crispy Crust Pizza
description: A deep-fried crispy crust topped with rich heavy cream sauce, processed cheddar, stringy mozzarella, and processed liquid cheese. Highly processed and high calorie.

item: Crispy Double Patty Fried Chicken Burger
description: Two deep-fried breaded chicken patties stacked in white flour buns with melted cheddar cheese slices, fried bacon strips, and heavy egg mayonnaise dressing.

item: Chocolate Fudge Cream Milkshake
description: A thick, high-sugar shake prepared with dairy ice cream, loaded chocolate syrup, heavy whipping cream, and sugary chocolate chips.

item: Fresh Lemon Water with Mint (No Sugar)
description: Hydrating chilled sparkling water flavored with freshly squeezed lime juice, fresh mint leaves, black salt, and a pinch of calorie-free stevia extract.

item: High Protein Egg White Scramble Wrap
description: Four scrambled egg whites cooked with baby spinach, tomatoes, and mushrooms, wrapped in a 100% whole wheat multi-grain tortilla wrap with greek yogurt dressing.

item: Sautéed Broccoli, Spinach & Quinoa Bowl
description: A vegan-friendly superfood bowl packed with lightly steamed broccoli florets, sautéed garlic spinach, boiled white quinoa, pumpkin seeds, and a low-oil lemon mustard dressing.

item: Healthy Millet Dosa with Sambhar & Chutney
description: Crisp fermented dosa prepared from high-fiber finger millet (ragi) and brown rice batter, served with traditional lentil-rich sambhar and fresh grated coconut chutney.

item: Herb Grilled Paneer & Olive Avocado Salad
description: Cubes of paneer pan-grilled with oregano and garlic, combined with black olives, Hass avocado cubes, cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, and arugula salad leaves.

item: Tandoori Chicken Tikka Whole Wheat Wrap
description: Juicy clay-roasted chicken tikka bites, wrapped inside a thin stone-ground whole wheat chapati with a bed of green cabbage slaw and fat-free mint yogurt.

item: Zero Sugar Chia Seed Coconut Pudding
description: A nutritious high-fiber dessert made with organic chia seeds soaked overnight in creamy unsweetened coconut milk, sweetened with erythritol and topped with roasted almonds.
